sentences.text: Sir Christopher Frank Carandini Lee -LRB- 27 May 1922 -- 7 June 2015 -RRB- was an English character actor , singer , and author .	character actor	character actor	singer	singer	author	author

With a career spanning nearly 70 years , Lee initially portrayed villains and became best known for his role as Count Dracula in a sequence of Hammer Horror films .	Count Dracula	Count Dracula	Hammer Horror	Hammer Film Productions

His other film roles include Francisco Scaramanga in the James Bond film The Man with the Golden Gun -LRB- 1974 -RRB- , Saruman in The Lord of the Rings film trilogy -LRB- 2001 -- 2003 -RRB- and The Hobbit film trilogy -LRB- 2012 -- 2014 -RRB- , and Count Dooku in the second and third films of the Star Wars prequel trilogy -LRB- 2002 and 2005 -RRB- .	Francisco Scaramanga	Francisco Scaramanga	James Bond film	James Bond (film series)	The Man with the Golden Gun	The Man with the Golden Gun (film)	Saruman	Saruman	Count Dooku	Count Dooku

Lee was knighted for services to drama and charity in 2009 , received the BAFTA Fellowship in 2011 , and received the BFI Fellowship in 2013 .	knighted	Knight Bachelor	BAFTA Fellowship	BAFTA Academy Fellowship Award	BFI Fellowship	British Film Institute Fellowship

Lee considered his best performance to be that of Pakistan 's founder Muhammad Ali Jinnah in the biopic Jinnah -LRB- 1998 -RRB- , and his best film to be the British horror film The Wicker Man -LRB- 1973 -RRB- .	Muhammad Ali Jinnah	Muhammad Ali Jinnah	Jinnah	Jinnah (film)	The Wicker Man	The Wicker Man (1973 film)

He frequently appeared opposite Peter Cushing in Hammer Horror films , and late in his career had roles in six Tim Burton films .	Hammer Horror	Hammer Film Productions	Peter Cushing	Peter Cushing	six Tim Burton films	List of frequent Tim Burton collaborators

Always noted as an actor for his deep , strong voice , Lee was also known for his singing ability , recording various opera and musical pieces between 1986 and 1998 , and the symphonic metal album Charlemagne : By the Sword and the Cross in 2010 , after having worked with several metal bands since 2005 .	symphonic metal	symphonic metal
The heavy metal follow-up Charlemagne : The Omens of Death was released on 27 May 2013 , Lee 's 91st birthday .	heavy metal	Heavy metal music
He was honoured with the `` Spirit of Metal '' award at the 2010 Metal Hammer Golden Gods Awards ceremony .	Metal Hammer	Metal Hammer	Golden Gods Awards	Metal Hammer Golden Gods Awards
Lee died from complications of respiratory problems and heart failure on the morning of 7 June 2015 , at the age of 93 .
